constraints.tm_formula: SantaLucia 1998 unified NN: Tm = dH/(dS + 1.987*ln(CT/4)) - 273.15 + 16.6*log10([Na+]), CT=0.25uM, [Na+]=50mM

notes: Greedy construction over 50242 uniformly random 20-mer candidates (seed 20261102); 1036 passed all per-sequence filters and 1024 were accepted after the cross-sequence checks. All 1024 requested indices were found; no constraint was relaxed. Per-candidate rejection counts: inverted_repeat=16751, no_leading_G=12538, gc_window=9793, tm_window=4838, homopolymer=4357, duplicate_6mer=342, restriction_site:GAAGAC=105, restriction_site:GTCTTC=97, restriction_site:GGTCTC=94, restriction_site:GAGACG=93, restriction_site:CGTCTC=89, restriction_site:GAGACC=69, restriction_site:GAAGAGC=26, restriction_site:GCTCTTC=14, cross:min_hamming=9, cross:unique_3prime=3. Tm uses SantaLucia 1998 unified nearest-neighbour parameters with CT=0.25 uM and [Na+]=50 mM, no terminal-initiation correction; the 3' 10 nt uniqueness is implied by the Hamming>=6 rule and is checked independently anyway. Inverted repeats are tested on all 4 nt windows of the sequence (any window that is the reverse complement of another window, itself included), which subsumes the palindrome ban and also covers every longer inverted repeat. Restriction sites GGTCTC, CGTCTC, GAAGAC and GCTCTTC are excluded on both strands. Realised GC 0.50-0.60 (mean 0.584) and Tm 55.0-59.8 C (mean 56.4). The 55 C Tm floor is the binding filter under these conditions, so the accepted set concentrates towards the top of the GC window; a GC of 0.40 is unreachable here without relaxing Tm or changing the stated salt/concentration assumptions.
